title: Ekitongole ekitali kya kugondera
intro: Mu nsi ez’edda, edda obuyinza obw’amaanyi bwafuga, nga buduumira eby’obugagga ebingi ennyo n’obulamu bw’abantu abatabalika. Wadde nga yalina obubonero obw’olwatu n’okulabula, omufuzi ono yalonda ekkubo ery’okujeemera, ekyaviirako okulwanagana okw’amaanyi okwandizzeemu okuyita mu biseera.
clues: Nnagamba nti nnina obuyinza n’obuyinza obw’enkomeredde ku kitundu ekinene ennyo.
Nasoomooza omubaka omwetoowaze eyasindikibwa Mukama w’amatwale gonna.
Abantu bange baali bamanyiddwa nnyo olw’okukuguka mu bizimbe ebinene n’omugga ogwayimirizaawo embuga yaffe.
Nnali mujulizi ku bubonero bungi obw’ekyamagero, omuli omuggo ogwafuuka omusota n’omukono ogwayakaayakana.
Nnagaana ekibinja ky’abantu abaali bafuuse abaddu okuva mu nsi yange, wadde nga Katonda yali alagidde.
Okugoberera kwange abantu abaali bagenda kwandeetera n’amagye gange mu mutima gw’ennyanja eyawuddwamu.
arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verse: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them. (7:136)
